decisions.reason: The finned tube is a core component for the firm's air coolers and fits its established offer, and the industry's growing turnover and the firm's slack (hiring, own R&D) give no shortfall signal that would trigger problemistic search, even though the 2020–2021 website evidence is missing.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are a technology-based component that supports many exchanger types across the portfolio, so with satisfactory industry performance and available slack, management has little reason to cut it despite having already pruned the more peripheral launches.
